acceptance_criteria: Two profiles with different concept sets never show each other's concepts or wording
The board works for a concept without a symbol
With no active profile and damaged entries present the board shows the damaged state, not the demo board and not a create-profile flow
When storage cannot be opened the demo board still works
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: The board renders the active child profile: its own ordered set of concepts with per-profile German label and sentence, including custom concepts stored in that profile's data. Without a profile the labelled synthetic demo board is shown; damaged profile storage is shown as its own state. A typed API lets a later caregiver screen pick, order, reword and add concepts.
non_goals: No caregiver editing screens or gestures to reach them (NG-13)
No custom symbol images or photos and no export format change (NG-27)
No profile order or creation field (NG-27)
No change to src/profiles/store.ts, profile.ts or backup.ts
